models.label: ECMWF IFS 0.25°
models.note: ECMWF's operational physics model, open-data release. Its gust field is a maximum over the output interval, not an instantaneous value, so gust factors look large in light air.

models.label: ECMWF AIFS
models.note: ECMWF's machine-learning model - a genuinely independent opinion. Publishes no gust field, so gusts come from IFS and ICON-2i only.

models.label: ItaliaMeteo ICON-2i
models.note: ItaliaMeteo / ARPAE high-resolution model for Italy - the finest grid available here. Runs only ~60-72 h ahead and updates every 12 h, so it drops out of the longer-range view.

models.label: Météo-France MFWAM
models.note: Full sea-state decomposition - total wave, wind wave and swell with heights, directions and periods.

models.label: ECMWF WAM 0.25°
models.note: Total significant wave height only - used to cross-check MFWAM.

briefing.headline: Light, benign pattern over the Aeolians now - but the forecast ends 1 Oct, three days short of our 4 Oct start.
briefing.synopsis: The current picture is slack-gradient: a weak westerly midday breeze on 25 Sep (ECMWF IFS 0.25°, 25 Sep 00Z, gives 7-11 kt W around Lipari, Filicudi and Salina at midday, with models split 7.2-14.0 kt at Panarea), collapsing to under 4 kt by evening. Through 26-27 Sep the wind backs into the NE and steadies at roughly 8-10 kt across the island group, touching 12.1 kt at Stromboli early on 27 Sep (IFS 25 Sep 00Z; models range 8.4-16.6 kt there, and 3.1-11.4 kt at Lipari the same hour). Seas stay small throughout - 0.3 to 2.1 ft total wave, swell 1.5 ft or less (MFWAM 24 Sep 12Z, cross-checked against ECMWF WAM 25 Sep 00Z). All available guidance stops at 1 Oct 23:00, so nothing here describes our trip dates.
briefing.overnight_anchorage: There is no fleet berth tonight - we are still eight days out. In the rehearsal run, Portorosa Marina scores as fully sheltered for the night of 25 Sep, which is what an enclosed basin does in any wind. On the rehearsal nights that follow, the light NE flow makes Porto Pignataro the pick at Lipari over Marina Lunga (NE 9 kt blows straight into the latter), and Drautto over San Pietro at Panarea. Treat those as a check on the method, not as a plan.
briefing.tomorrow_morning: Nothing to depart for tomorrow. For context, the rehearsal Portorosa-Lipari run on 26 Sep scores 'go' at 06:00 with 7.9 kt on a beam reach (IFS 25 Sep 00Z). Our real departure window for 4 Oct will not come into model range until roughly 30 Sep, and will not firm up until two or three days before.

passage_notes.note: Rehearsed 26 Sep: 'go' at 06:00, 7.9 kt beam reach. Trip date beyond all model horizons.
Rehearsed 27 Sep: 'go', 8.6 kt on the nose - motoring leg in that pattern. Out of range for the actual date.
Rehearsed 28 Sep: 'go', 2.2 kt broad reach. Gabbiano only rates 'workable' - it is open all round and depends on calm holding.
Rehearsed 29 Sep: 'go', 2.0 kt. Gusts to 6 kt are interval-maxima in light air, not a concern.
Rehearsed 30 Sep: 'go', 2.8 kt close reach, gusts to 10 kt. Longest open leg - worth re-checking once in range.
Rehearsed 1 Oct: 'go', 2.9 kt close reach. This is the last hour any model covers.

cautions: The trip dates (4-8 Oct) are entirely outside the forecast, which reaches only 1 Oct 23:00. Nothing in this briefing should be carried forward as an expectation for the passages themselves.

Midday gust figures of 33.2 kt at Stromboli and Filicudi on 25 Sep are IFS interval-maxima over the output window in light mean wind (8-11 kt), not sustained values - noted for awareness, not as a warning.
Where models_range_kt appears - Panarea 25 Sep midday (7.2-14.0 kt), Lipari and Stromboli 27 Sep 00:00 (3.1-11.4 and 8.4-16.6 kt) - the models genuinely disagree; do not treat the mean as settled.
ICON-2i runs only ~60-72 h ahead and AIFS publishes no gust field, so the longer-range view thins out to IFS and the wave models.
briefing.confidence_note: Confidence in the present pattern is reasonable - stability tracking shows mean wind shifts of only 1.0-1.3 kt at 24-120 h lead - but direction drifts a mean 49 degrees by 72-120 h, and the trip dates sit beyond every model's horizon entirely.

verification.measures: forecast stability, not verified accuracy - the reference is the newest model run for the same hour, not an observation
